title: Heavy-Duty Trucks in 2027: Sales Are Falling, But Why Do They Hold Value?
description:
The trucks that keep their value best, and the trucks most likely to last two hundred fifty thousand miles, are not the ones most people buy. They are heavy-duty pickups. And their sales are falling. In nine months, the three biggest heavy-duty lines lost more than twenty-two thousand sales. One heavy truck was just discontinued. Here is what the numbers say about heavy-duty trucks heading into twenty twenty-seven.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:05 The whole class
3:18 1. Ram HD
4:51 2. Chevrolet Silverado HD
6:24 3. GMC Sierra HD
7:24 4. Ford Super Duty
9:00 5. Chevrolet Silverado medium-duty
13:56 The final twist
15:39 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
For this video, we gathered five kinds of numbers. Sales, from the Pickup Truck Talk table for the first nine months of twenty twenty-six. Resale value, from iSeeCars. Longevity, from the iSeeCars study reported by Work Truck Online. Ford's production figures, from Ford Authority. And the medium-duty trucks, from Motor One and GM Authority. Every source is listed in the description, and every number is labeled.
